propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800 lines with mixed concerns (file loading, unknown-field preservation, tempfile cleanup, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, retired-state replacement, alert persistence) that risk silent data loss when moved without fault oracles

BindingRepository must preserve every existing load/save byte contract, exception contract, rotation-before-live ordering, retired-first move ordering, and exact sorted/indented/newline serialization without introducing multi-file atomicity claims
Public BindingStore facade must remain unchanged in construction, loader, signatures, shared inner dictionaries, and caller-visible exceptions after repository extraction
GET rotation must be durably attempted before live replacement; failed sidecar saves must retain the newest inline floor and allow later convergence
Tickets publication must stage only the existing five allowlisted bridge-state files with no new checkpoint commits or broad staging logic

The binding-lifecycle ADR must distinguish repository unit-of-work durability from tickets publication and document recovery boundaries without permitting format migration, eager rewrites, or general journaling
